{{Quote|The ice age is the result of a moonstrike.''"<br />"''Yes, it would appear so. The smaller moon was a capture moon, with an irregular orbit. Working backward from Artoo's recordings, we found that the gravity of the larger moon disturbed the capture moon into a decaying orbit&mdash;a hundred years, in round numbers, before the fall.''"<br />"''And the Qella saw it happening. They knew what lay ahead for them. And they used the warning, and the time they had left, to build this vessel.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Joto Eckels]]|<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>}}
A '''moonstrike''' was known as an occasion when a satellite was hit with enough force by an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], [[Moon/Legends|moon]], or other natural satellite to alter its [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] or rotational axis.
